explanation: Emit each square layer’s top, right, bottom and left edges clockwise without repeating its corners. Move inward one layer at a time and handle a lone center entry separately.
timeComplexity: O(n^2) time for an n-by-n square.
spaceComplexity: O(1) auxiliary space excluding the O(n^2) result.
